# Planting Science

> Planting Science connects students, teachers, and scientists in inquiry-based plant research projects aligned with Next Generation Science Standards.

Planting Science is an innovative STEM education platform that facilitates student-scientist partnerships, enabling middle and high school students to conduct authentic plant science research with guidance from volunteer mentors. The program emphasizes hands-on inquiry-based learning and is supported by partnerships with scientific societies including the Botanical Society of America.

## Key Topics

- Inquiry-based learning
- Plant science education
- Student-scientist mentorship
- STEM outreach
- Master Plant Science Team (MPST)
- Next Generation Science Standards (NGSS)
- Mentor program
- Middle and high school students
- Science literacy
- Student research projects
- Volunteer mentorship
- Botanical Society of America
- Science practices
- Plant-based learning

## Getting Started

- [Planting Science - Home](https://plantingscience.org): PlantingScience homepage: student-teacher-scientist partnership for plant-based learning
- [Planting Science - What We Do](https://plantingscience.org/about): PlantingScience mission and program overview aligned with NGSS standards
- [Planting Science - What We Do](https://plantingscience.org/aboutus): PlantingScience organizational information and educational approach

## Get Involved

- [Planting Science - How to Join PlantingScience](https://plantingscience.org/getinvolved): Overview of ways to join PlantingScience as teacher, mentor, or MPST member
- [Planting Science - Join PlantingScience as a Teacher](https://plantingscience.org/getinvolved/joinplantingscience): Teacher registration guide for 6th-12th grade classroom participation
- [Planting Science - Become a Mentor](https://plantingscience.org/getinvolved/mentor): Guide for scientists to volunteer as online mentors for student projects
- [Planting Science - Master Plant Science Team](https://plantingscience.org/getinvolved/joinmpst): Master Plant Science Team leadership application and requirements
- [Planting Science - Partners](https://plantingscience.org/getinvolved/partners): Scientific society partnerships including Botanical Society of America

## Learning Resources

- [Planting Science - Examples of PlantingScience Projects](https://plantingscience.org/about/sampleprojects): Sample student research projects from Henry P. Becton High School and others
- [Planting Science - Fall 2025 Star Projects](https://plantingscience.org/starprojects/sp-recent): Award-winning student projects from Fall 2025 competition
